title: 第1章 张绝字绍先第2章 太平道
slug: 老乡你咋还会搓火球嘞
content_zh:
“新民国自成立以来，四任大总统就在无数的公开场合宣称过，绝对会坚持革除旧法，发展新法的政纲！”
“新职业运动在南十六省进行的如火如荼，就算是依旧处于后金鼠妖威胁的北部省份也都各自进行了新职业改革！”
“无论是中原的斥候、齐鲁的圣职，还是徽州的血术士，皆是康庄大道！更不论西北的锤手、闽州的隐市金商、武陵的狂暴骑士也都是良路！”
“而我江南省的散星法师是新民国民众公认的，最具前途，最能有机会救国救民的职业！”
“可现任江南行省总督安焕然他在干什么！他居然公开发布职业者任务，拿出高价悬赏要找一把与旧法有关的剑！”
熙熙攘攘的学校门前，头戴八角学生帽，身穿文明装的青年学子正在高台上举着扩音筒，痛心疾首地大呼。
“同学们！如此蔑视新民国政府，蔑视《公允法》的行径，我们绝不能接受！”
“不能接受！”
“就算我们现在还没有通过考核，成为真正的职业者，我们也要明白天下兴亡，匹夫有责的道理！不能像张绍先这类人一样自甘堕落，甘于平庸！”
“同学们！我们必须要上街抗议游行！让安焕然他看到，让天下人看到，旧法早就已经被证明了它的落后与愚昧！只有新职业才能真正带领这片土地重回巅峰！”
在慷慨激昂的演说中，台下无数学生的爱国保法之心被点燃，他们呼喊着口号，举着手中事先准备好的旗帜，在江宁城市民的注视下，开始了这场轰轰烈烈的大游行。
“绍先！绍先！你不一起去吗？我们一起去省厅，让安总督收回那条任务啊！”
刚从酱油铺走出来的张绝，听到了路边有平时关系还算不错的同学在呼喊他。
喊住他的人叫方勉，是个好性子，就算平时一直在学校独来独往的张绝，他也能搭上几句话。
面对他的邀请，张绝只是拎着刚打好的酱油摆了摆手。
“我都被点名批评了还去什么？”
“哎呀，于中甫不是那个意思，他只是想要激励你！现在你和我们一起去，正是让大家对你印象改观的时候啊！”
“好意我心领了，但我现在还是回家好好去反省吧。”
张绝没和他有多余的纠缠，这句话说完，便悠哉游哉地转身朝着游行队伍相反的方向离去。
看到他远去的背影，方勉刚想要追上去继续劝，身边就有同伴拉着了他。

“懋卿，你管他干什么？他没有成为职业者的希望，再加上整日碌碌无为，学校已经考虑让他退学了。你可是江南的明日之星，未来肯定是要去剑阁军校的，和这种人扯上关系，对你以后没好处！”
但被拉着的方勉还在坚持。
“这样说绝非君子之言！绍先每天帮助邻里，尊老爱幼，怎么能说是碌碌无为......”
“为小善而不做救国救民的大善，那就是自甘堕落，碌碌无为！”
“你！”
“走吧！我们快走！”
......
“老刘头，你的酱油。”
张绝将打好的一整瓶酱油摆在了破旧的木桌上。
躺在床上老鳏夫姓刘，孑然一身，平日以拉黄包车为生，只是前两天不小心摔断了腿，如今只能躺在家里休养。
如果没有张绝这些天帮衬着来照顾他，以他这无依无靠的样子，连最基本的生活都没办法自理。
老刘头从床上坐起身来，他脸色复杂地看着张绝，那眼神中明显带着感激却又夹杂着些许警惕。
“绝哥儿，我那些积蓄可是要当棺材本的.....”
“你这话都快说八百遍了。”张绝一边帮他筛米一边翻了个白眼。
“我要是真想从你身上图点什么东西，在你刚断腿的时候，就把你藏在陶罐里的那点钱全都搜刮光了。”
content_en:
"Since the founding of the New Republic of China, the four presidents have declared on countless public occasions that they will absolutely adhere to the political platform of abolishing the old laws and developing new laws!"
"The new profession movement is in full swing in the sixteen southern provinces. Even the northern provinces, which are still under the threat of the post-Golden Rat Demon, have each carried out new profession reforms!"
"Whether it is the scouts of the Central Plains, the priesthood of Qilu, or the blood magicians of Huizhou, they are all good roads! Not to mention the hammer hands of the northwest, the gold merchants of Yinshi in Minzhou, and the violent knights of Wuling are also good roads!"
"And I, Master Sanxing of Jiangnan Province, is recognized by the people of the New Republic of China as the most promising profession with the best chance of saving the country and the people!"
"But what is the current governor of Jiangnan Province, An Huanran, doing! He actually publicly issued a professional mission and offered a high price reward to find a sword related to the old law!"
In front of the bustling school, young students wearing octagonal student hats and civilized clothes were holding a loudspeaker on a high platform and shouting sadly.
"Students! We will never accept such behavior that shows contempt for the new Republic of China government and the Fairness Law!"
"Unacceptable!"
"Even if we haven't passed the exam yet and become true professionals, we still have to understand that everyone is responsible for the rise and fall of the world! We can't be like people like Zhang Shaoxian who are willing to degenerate and be mediocre!"
"Students! We must take to the streets to protest and march! Let An Huanran see it and let the world see that the old law has long been proven to be backward and ignorant! Only new professions can truly lead this land back to its peak!"
In the impassioned speech, the patriotism and law-defending hearts of countless students in the audience were ignited. They shouted slogans, held up the flags prepared in advance, and started this vigorous parade under the gaze of the citizens of Jiangning City.
"Shaoxian! Shaoxian! Why don't you go together? Let's go to the provincial office together and let Governor An take back the mission!"
Zhang Jue, who had just walked out of the soy sauce shop, heard a classmate with whom he usually had a good relationship calling him on the roadside.
The person who called him was Fang Mian. He was a good-natured man. Even Zhang Jue, who usually stayed alone in school, could chat with him for a few words.
Facing his invitation, Zhang Jue just waved his hand while holding the freshly made soy sauce.
"Why should I go after I've been named and criticized?"
"Oh, Yu Zhongfu didn't mean that, he just wanted to inspire you! Now that you are going with us, it is time for everyone to change their impression of you!"
"I appreciate the good intentions, but I'd better go home and reflect on it now."
Zhang Jue did not have any unnecessary entanglement with him. After saying this, he turned around and left in the opposite direction of the parade.
Seeing his retreating figure, Fang Mian just wanted to catch up and continue to persuade him, when a companion pulled him beside him.
"Mao Qing, what do you care about him? He has no hope of becoming a professional, and since he has been doing nothing all day long, the school has already considered letting him drop out of school. You are a rising star in Jiangnan, and you will definitely go to Jiange Military Academy in the future. Being associated with such a person will not be good for you in the future!"
But Fang Mian, who was being pulled, still persisted.
"It is not the words of a gentleman to say this! Shaoxian helps his neighbors every day, respects the elderly and loves the young. How can he say that he is doing nothing..."
"Doing small good deeds instead of doing the great good deeds of saving the country and the people is a sign of self-destruction and inaction!"
"You!"
"Let's go! Let's go quickly!"
...
"Old Liu Tou, your soy sauce."
Zhang Jue placed a whole bottle of soy sauce on the old wooden table.
Lying on the bed, an old widower named Liu was alone. He usually made a living by pulling a rickshaw, but he accidentally broke his leg two days ago. Now he can only lie at home to recuperate.
Without Zhang Jue's help and care for him these days, he would be helpless and unable to take care of himself even with the most basic life.
Old Liu Tou sat up from the bed.He looked at Zhang Jue with a complicated expression, his eyes obviously filled with gratitude but also mixed with a little vigilance.
"Brother Jue, my savings are going to be used as coffin books..."
"You've said this almost eight hundred times." Zhang Jue rolled his eyes while helping him sift rice.
"If I really wanted to get something from you, I would have plundered all the money you hid in the clay pot when you just broke your leg."
